Method RUN from class CL_CI_TESTS (lines 1536-1574 of 1819, 39 method lines):

```abap
method RUN.
  data:
    L_REF_TEST type ref to CL_CI_TEST_ROOT,
    L_1PRG     type FLAG,
    L_PROGRAM_NAME type PROGRAM,
    L_OBJNAME      type TROBJ_NAME.

  loop at LIST into L_REF_TEST.
    L_REF_TEST->CLEAR( ).
    L_REF_TEST->_ERRCNT = 0.
  endloop.

*-- downstream program name calculation for web dynpro
  if P_OBJECT_TYPE = 'WDYN'.
     L_OBJNAME = P_OBJECT_NAME.
     L_PROGRAM_NAME = CL_CI_OBJECTSET=>GET_PROGRAM(
         P_PGMID   = 'R3TR'
         P_OBJTYPE = P_OBJECT_TYPE
         P_OBJNAME = L_OBJNAME ).
  else.
     L_PROGRAM_NAME = P_PROGRAM_NAME.
  endif.

  CL_CI_TEST_ROOT=>OBJECT_TYPE  = P_OBJECT_TYPE.
  CL_CI_TEST_ROOT=>OBJECT_NAME  = P_OBJECT_NAME.
  CL_CI_TEST_ROOT=>PROGRAM_NAME = L_PROGRAM_NAME.

  if L_PROGRAM_NAME is not initial.
    L_1PRG = 'X'.
  endif.

  loop at LIST into L_REF_TEST.
    check L_1PRG = 'X' and
          '1PRG'        in L_REF_TEST->TYPELIST  or
          P_OBJECT_TYPE in L_REF_TEST->TYPELIST.
    L_REF_TEST->RUN( ).
  endloop.

endmethod.                    "run
```
